summary: Bark, Inc. filed an 8-K announcing its Board authorized a $40 million stock repurchase program, funded by ongoing free cash flow. No price per share, premium, or expiration date was specified; repurchases may occur in open market or private transactions under Rule 10b-18 and 10b5-1. Management determines timing and volume based on market conditions and liquidity. The program does not obligate the company to buy any specific number of shares. Watch for actual buyback execution pace and impact on diluted share count.
